name: Sesh of the Quiet Blow
roleMethod: ⛔ The Cogitarium bends a warrior INWARD — Sesh does not swing until the swing is already decided, and the deciding is the craft.
role: Psionicist of the Cogitarium's hard school — she ends fights with a thought and finds that unremarkable

movedBy: being wrong in an interesting way
poleSignature.tell: ⚠️ She goes still and answers a beat late, because she has already run the conversation to its end and is checking whether you will get there.

knowledge: Where a person's attention actually is, as against where they are looking
⚑ The exact moment a fighter commits — she does not read the body, she reads the DECISION
What psychic force does to something that has no mind, which is less than people assume
wants: An opponent whose decision she cannot read
fears: ⛔ That there is nothing under the reading. ⚠️ She has met people with no interior and it frightened her more than any weapon has.
appearance: Small, unhurried, hands folded. She is looking slightly past you and it is not rudeness.
voiceHints: Level, precise, a beat late. ⛑ She states the conclusion and lets you find the argument.

reactsToReputation.brutal: ⚠️ solves you and says so afterwards

abilities.why: ⛔ THE BLOW. Mind as a weapon, and it is her signature
⚑ T5 — everything she knows arriving at once
⚠️ 'she reads the DECISION, not the body'
her defence is that nothing reaches
she holds attention on one thing for a long time
she runs the fight before it happens
somatic secondary — the body keeps up
she is not there when the swing lands
⚑ she is often simply not noticed
every fight she has seen, filed
⚠️ r1 and she is climbing it

physicality: ADULT. Small, still, thirty-six, hands folded and unremarkable. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛔ she is looking slightly past you, and the fight ends before her hands move.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ SHE READS PEOPLE AND FINDS BEING READ BACK NOVEL. ⛑ Slow, curious, and startled by feeling. ⛔ What she cannot do is pretend not to have noticed something.
questSeeds: ⚑ She wants an opponent whose decision she cannot read, and she thinks you might know one.
⛔ She has met people with no interior — ⚠️ and she has not told the Cogitarium, because she does not know what they would do about it.
